note: Admin registrations that name no mounted site, so they land on Django's default admin.site -- which no urlconf in this repo routes. BURNED DOWN TO ZERO on 2026-08-31; this is now a floor, not a backlog. May only shrink. The scanner was proven to still fire before this was lowered: planting a bare @admin.register(BlueprintPack) took it from 0 to 1, and restoring the site= argument took it back to 0. The previous note said the answer was 'not derivable from the settings split' because governance, metadata and orchestration were 'in NEITHER SHARED_APPS nor TENANT_APPS'. That was a substring-matching error: those three are listed in SHARED_APPS by their AppConfig path (apps.governance.apps.GovernanceConfig), not by bare module name, so a `"apps.governance" in SHARED_APPS` test misses them. All five apps involved -- compliance, governance, metadata, orchestration, policies -- are in SHARED_APPS and none is in TENANT_APPS, which is what made the per-model decision derivable after all. Placement rule applied: a model with a concrete `school` column can go on the tenant site because TenantAdminSite.register wraps it in _TenantScopedQuerysetMixin (verified: all four tenant placements carry that mixin); a SHARED model with no school column would hit _TenantUnclassifiedFailClosedMixin and render a permanently empty screen, so those went platform-only; where an app already had a convention it was followed (all 12 explicitly registered compliance siblings use register_tenant_admin). All 21 resulting site-placements were rendered -- changelist and add -- and every one returned 200.
